paper.title: Agentic Retrieval for Regulatory Filings: Multi-Hop Question Answering over 10-K Reports
paper.summary: We present an agent that plans multi-hop retrieval over financial filings and regulatory documents, improving answer accuracy for credit risk and compliance questions while citing every source passage.

paper.title: Small Language Models for Predictive Maintenance on Factory Floors
paper.summary: A 3B-parameter model fine-tuned on maintenance logs and sensor summaries predicts equipment failures in manufacturing and logistics fleets, running on edge hardware without cloud access.

paper.title: Protein Language Models Meet Clinical Trial Design
paper.summary: We use protein and clinical text embeddings to shortlist drug candidates and patient cohorts, cutting the search space for clinical trials in health care.

paper.title: Grid-Aware Forecasting with Foundation Models for Renewable Energy
paper.summary: A time-series foundation model forecasts solar and wind output for power grid operators and utilities, with calibrated uncertainty for energy trading.

paper.title: Evaluating LLM Judges: When Automated Evaluation Disagrees with Experts
paper.summary: We measure how often LLM-as-judge evaluation disagrees with domain experts across finance, medical and legal tasks, and propose a calibration protocol.

paper.title: Materials Discovery with Generative Models and Autonomous Labs
paper.summary: Generative chemistry models propose catalyst and battery materials that robotic labs synthesise and test, closing the loop between molecule design and experiment.
